messages:
alex_infra: rolling oob fw 2.1.0 to eu-west rack-7 now. quick heads-up — ~6 nodes came back with PXE disabled and watchdog=enabled, forced them into local-fallback boot. GPUs present but drivers missing. rolling those 6 back first. anyone seen 2.1.0 do this?

jamie_sre: saw something similar in staging last week. oob FW touched NVRAM area and one board had a bad checksum, resulted in pxe_policy flip. ipmitool lan print showed boot params changed.

pat_hw: confirmed — fw writes to sec flags region and a crc fail will flip the PXE bit on some BMC revisions. I have a quick remediation loop we used:

pat_hw: ```
for node in $NODES; do
  ipmitool -H $node -U admin -P $PASS chassis bootdev pxe && \\n  ipmitool -H $node raw 0x30 0x70 0x0c
done
```

oob-bot: deploy-bot: fw-update eu-west rack-7 completed 02:12 UTC. postcheck: 6/96 nodes failed healthcheck -> flagged for manual rollback.

alex_infra: doing manual power-cycle + re-assert PXE on the 6. reimage of GPU nodes takes ~45m each (driver + nv-kv restore). pausing the rest of the batch.

jamie_sre: add affected hosts to /infra/oob/blocked and run `oob-agent repair --keep-nvram`. also open vendor ticket, attach /var/log/oob-update.log. snippet below.

pat_hw: log snippet:
[00:47:13] fw-write: nvm_crc mismatch
[00:47:13] secure_toggle: pxe flag 0 -> 1
[00:47:13] watchdog: set=1
[00:47:13] oob-net: tx fragments detected (len 980/mtu 1400)

pat_hw: side note — we hit fragmented IPMI writes on older ToR/uplink path. MTU was 1400 on the OOB VLAN; bumping to 1500 cleared partial writes in one case. worth verifying OOB VLAN MTU across eu-west racks.

ops-rotation: cost math: manual rollback + reimages ~5.5h ops time right now, plus risk if we continue batch (potentially 6/96 * more). recommend holding non-critical eu-west racks and escalate vendor.

alex_infra: paused remainder of the rollout. I'll create an incident doc in #incidents and ping @pat_hw to own vendor ticket. quick checklist:
- mark hosts in /infra/oob/blocked
- run oob-agent repair with --keep-nvram
- verify OOB VLAN MTU = 1500 end-to-end
- vendor ticket + attach logs

jamie_sre: adding runbook link: /runbooks/oob/fw-rollback (use 'safeboot' branch) and callout to avoid automated postchecks for next batch until vendor confirms fix. :thumbsup:

alex_infra: thanks — will update incident once fixes live.
